# "The Armor of God"
## Scripture
"Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the schemes of the devil." – Ephesians 6:11
## Reflection
As men, we often face battles that seem insurmountable. We struggle with doubt, fear, and weakness. But God has provided us with the armor we need to stand strong in these battles. Paul reminds us that we must put on the whole armor of God – not just some of it, but all of it. This includes the belt of truth, the breastplate of righteousness, the shoes of the gospel of peace, the shield of faith, the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit. When we wear this armor, we are equipped to face any challenge that comes our way. We are not just fighting our own battles, but we are fighting for our families, our communities, and our faith. Let us put on the whole armor of God and stand strong against the schemes of the devil.
## Daily Challenge
"Do 10 burpees while praying for strength and protection in the spiritual battles you face."
